name: std::chrono::current_zone
intro: Convenience function for obtaining local time zone from the time zone database. Equivalent to std::chrono::get_tzdb().current_zone().

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: std::runtime_error if this is the first reference to the time zone database and the time zone database cannot be initialized.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A call to this function that is the first reference to the time zone database will cause it to be initialized.

summary: Convenience function for obtaining local time zone from the time zone database. Equivalent to std::chrono::get_tzdb().current_zone().
